resources.string: Show indentation guides without changing the document.
Highlight enclosing Java/Kotlin/C/C++/JSON/JSONC brackets and XML/SVG/HTML tags. Skip strings and comments allowed by each language.

While the caret sits inside an argument list, show the parameters of the call like IntelliJ IDEA: one line per overload, the current parameter in bold and the parameters still missing highlighted. Java asks the code analysis engine, so library methods are included; Kotlin uses the declarations of the current file. Otherwise show the declaration of the identifier under the caret (current file only).

Fold multi-line blocks: tap the small triangle at the end of the first line in a block to fold it, and the … badge with the hidden line count to unfold. Uses the bracket and tag pairs of Java, Kotlin, C/C++, JSON/JSONC and XML/SVG/HTML. The closing line stays visible.
Pin the enclosing scopes to the top of the editor while scrolling and tap one to jump back. Uses the bracket and tag pairs of Java, Kotlin, C/C++, JSON/JSONC and XML/SVG/HTML.
Outline the other occurrences of the identifier at the caret. Lexical only: strings, comments and keywords are skipped, and same-named symbols from other scopes still match.

Pair brackets and quotes, wrap selections and delete empty pairs in Java, Kotlin, C/C++, AIDL, Gradle/Groovy, Dart, Lua, TOML, shell, CMake, smali and JSON/JSONC. Close XML/SVG tags and pair or delete empty attribute quotes. Turning this off keeps native editing.
Show live diagnostic summaries after source text. Tap a summary for details; build errors remain in the Problems list.
Use the bundled JetBrains Mono so that ->, !=, >= and similar operators are drawn as ligatures. A custom font path above takes precedence; turn off to use the system monospace font.

Re-indent pasted lines with the code analysis engine; the editor waits for the result. Pastes over 2000 lines are not formatted (a message says so). Turn off to paste immediately without re-indenting.
